From: dana.whitfield@crestlinebrokerage.com
Subject: New submission - Brightline Bakery LLC - GL + Property

Hi team,
Please quote GL and property for Brightline Bakery LLC, a retail bakery with two storefronts in Columbus, OH.
They've been operating since 2014. Revenue last FY was about $2.4M.

--- ACORD 125 (excerpt) ---
Applicant: Brightline Bakery, LLC
NAICS: 311811
Mailing address: 88 Front St, Columbus, OH 43215
Annual revenues: $2,400,000
Lines of business: Commercial General Liability; Commercial Property

--- SOV summary ---
Location 1: 88 Front St - building + BPP: $1,900,000
Location 2: 412 High St - BPP only: $1,200,000
Total insured value: $3,100,000

--- Loss run (5 yrs, carrier-reported) ---
2023-03-14  slip-and-fall, customer  paid $18,500  closed
No other claims reported.

label.rationale: All required fields are present, one closed claim, TIV well under the limit, so nothing triggers a refer or decline.
reasons: G7: within appetite (TIV $3.1M, 1 claim in 5 years, 12 years in business).

text:
From: marco.ruiz@atlanticriskpartners.com
Subject: RE: Harbor Point Cold Storage - property renewal submission

Team - resending with corrected financials. Harbor Point Cold Storage Inc. runs refrigerated warehousing (NAICS 493120) out of Newark, NJ, in business 22 years.
Earlier email said revenue of $18M; correction: FY2025 audited revenue is $16.5M, please use that.

ACORD 125
Named insured: Harbor Point Cold Storage Inc.
State: NJ
Annual revenue: 18,000,000
Coverage requested: Property, Equipment Breakdown

Statement of values
Bldg A (freezer) ..... $38,000,000
Bldg B (dry/cold dock) $24,000,000
TOTAL TIV ............ $62,000,000

Loss history (5 yr): 2022 ammonia leak $240k; 2024 roof collapse (snow) $1.1M. 2 claims total.

label.rationale: The broker's correction settles revenue at $16.5M, but TIV of $62M is over the $50M refer threshold.

fwd: sub for Summit Ridge Energy Partners LP

hey - new biz, Summit Ridge Energy Partners LP, crude oil & natural gas extraction in the Permian (Midland, Texas). NAICS 211120. est. 2009.
rev approx $41M; TIV $27.5M across 3 well-site locations + field office. Looking for GL, Pollution Liability, Property.
3 claims last 5 yrs (2 equipment, 1 vehicle).
- Priya

label.rationale: NAICS 211120 is oil and gas extraction, an excluded class, so decline regardless of the other fields.
reasons: G1: NAICS 211120 (oil & gas extraction) is an excluded class.
